draw_agent_body :: proc(foot: rl.Vector3, color: ui.Color) {
	rl.DrawCapsule(foot + {0, AGENT_RADIUS, 0}, foot + {0, AGENT_HEIGHT - AGENT_RADIUS, 0}, AGENT_RADIUS, AGENT_CAPSULE_SLICES, AGENT_CAPSULE_RINGS, rl.Color(color))
}

on_site_guest_foot :: proc(site: sim.Site, guest: sim.Guest) -> (rl.Vector3, bool) {
	if !sim.is_guest_on_site(guest) do return {}, false
	agent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.agents, sim.guest_agent_handle(guest))
	assert(is_found)
	return subtile_floor_point(agent.position), true
}

crew_foot :: proc(site: sim.Site, crew: sim.Crew) -> rl.Vector3 {
	agent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.agents, crew.agent)
	assert(is_found)
	return subtile_floor_point(agent.position)
}

draw_guests :: proc(site: sim.Site) {
	for slot in site.guests.slots {
		if !slot.is_occupied do continue
		guest := slot.value
		foot := on_site_guest_foot(site, guest) or_continue
		rl.DrawCylinder(foot, GUEST_BASE_RADIUS, GUEST_BASE_RADIUS, AGENT_BASE_HEIGHT, GUEST_BASE_SLICES, rl.Color(arrival_outline_color(guest.arrival_type)))
		draw_agent_body(foot, guest_state_color(guest.state))
	}
}

crew_state_color :: proc(state: sim.Crew_State) -> ui.Color {
	switch _ in state {
	case sim.Idle:
		return IDLE_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Walking_To_Job:
		return WALKING_TO_JOB_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Working:
		return WORKING_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Returning:
		return RETURNING_CREW_COLOR
	}
	unreachable()
}

draw_crew :: proc(site: sim.Site) {
	for slot, index in site.crew.slots {
		if !slot.is_occupied do continue
		foot := crew_foot(site, slot.value)
		draw_box_on(foot, CREW_BASE_HALF_SIZE, AGENT_BASE_HEIGHT, CREW_OUTLINE_COLOR)
		draw_agent_body(foot, crew_state_color(slot.value.state))
		if _, is_carrying := sim.crew_carried_item(site, sim.pool_slot_handle(site.crew, index)); is_carrying do draw_carried_box(foot)
	}
}

draw_carried_box :: proc(foot: rl.Vector3) {
	draw_box_on(foot + {0, AGENT_HEIGHT + CARRIED_BOX_CLEARANCE, 0}, CARRIED_BOX_HALF_SIZE, CARRIED_BOX_HALF_SIZE * 2, CARRIED_BOX_COLOR)
}

job_activity_text :: proc(work: sim.Job_Work) -> (text: string, has_activity: bool) {
	switch value in work {
	case sim.Room_Upkeep:
		return UPKEEP_ACTIVITY_LABELS[value.task], true
	case sim.Haul:
		return HAUL_ACTIVITY_LABELS[haul_stage(value)], true
	}
	return "", false
}

haul_stage :: proc(haul: sim.Haul) -> Haul_Stage {
	return .Drop_Off if haul.is_picked_up else .Pick_Up
}

away_guest_count :: proc(site: sim.Site) -> int {
	count := 0
	for slot in site.guests.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && !sim.is_guest_on_site(slot.value) do count += 1
	}
	return count
}

open_job_count :: proc(site: sim.Site) -> int {
	count := 0
	for slot in site.jobs.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && sim.can_job_take_crew(site, slot.value) do count += 1
	}
	return count
}

guest_activity_text :: proc(site: sim.Site, state: sim.Guest_State) -> (text: string, has_activity: bool) {
	#partial switch value in state {
	case sim.Walking_To_Furnishing:
		furnishing := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, value.furnishing) or_return
		if sim.ACTIVITY_ADVERTISEMENTS[value.activity].is_off_site do return fmt.tprintf("-> %s", OFF_SITE_DESTINATION_LABEL), true
		return fmt.tprintf("-> %s", FURNISHING_LABELS[furnishing.type]), true
	case sim.Using_Furnishing:
		return GUEST_ACTIVITY_LABELS[value.activity], true
	}
	return "", false
}

furnishing_tiles_bounds :: proc(type: sim.Furnishing_Type, tiles: sim.Tile_Rectangle) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return tile_rectangle_bounds(tiles, FLOOR_HEIGHT, shape_height(type))
}

furnishing_bounds :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return placed_furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing.type, furnishing.tiles, furnishing.slot, furnishing.rotation)
}

placed_furnishing_bounds :: proc(
	site: sim.Site,
	type: sim.Furnishing_Type,
	tiles: sim.Tile_Rectangle,
	slot: Maybe(sim.Slot),
	rotation: sim.Rotation,
) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	mounted, has_slot := slot.?
	if !has_slot do return furnishing_tiles_bounds(type, tiles)
	return slot_bounds(site, type, mounted, rotation)
}

furnishing_facing :: proc(furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> sim.Rotation {
	slot, has_slot := furnishing.slot.?
	if !has_slot do return facing_toward_tile(furnishing.tiles, furnishing.interaction_tile)
	return slot_facing(slot, furnishing.rotation)
}

slot_facing :: proc(slot: sim.Slot, rotation: sim.Rotation) -> sim.Rotation {
	wall_slot, is_on_wall := slot.(sim.Wall_Slot)
	if is_on_wall do return wall_slot_facing(wall_slot)
	return rotation
}

slot_bounds :: proc(site: sim.Site, type: sim.Furnishing_Type, slot: sim.Slot, rotation: sim.Rotation) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	footprint := sim.FURNISHING_DEFINITIONS[type].footprint
	switch s in slot {
	case sim.Floor_Slot:
		cells := sim.floor_slot_cells(s, footprint, rotation)
		minimum := cell_floor_point(cells.minimum)
		maximum := cell_floor_point(cells.minimum + cells.size)
		return {min = {minimum.x, FLOOR_HEIGHT, minimum.y}, max = {maximum.x, shape_height(type), maximum.y}}
	case sim.Wall_Slot:
		return wall_slot_bounds(s, footprint)
	case sim.Surface_Slot:
		parent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, s.parent)
		assert(is_found)
		parent_bounds := furnishing_bounds(site, parent)
		center := (parent_bounds.min + parent_bounds.max) / 2
		half_size := cell_floor_point(sim.rotate_size(footprint, rotation)) / 2
		return {
			min = {center.x - half_size.x, parent_bounds.max.y, center.z - half_size.y},
			max = {center.x + half_size.x, parent_bounds.max.y + shape_height(type), center.z + half_size.y},
		}
	}
	unreachable()
}

cell_floor_point :: proc(cell: [2]int) -> rl.Vector2 {
	return {f32(cell.x) / sim.FLOOR_SLOTS_PER_TILE_SIDE, f32(cell.y) / sim.FLOOR_SLOTS_PER_TILE_SIDE}
}

WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT :: (WALL_HEIGHT - FLOOR_HEIGHT) / sim.WALL_SLOT_ROWS

wall_slot_row_bottom :: proc(row: int) -> f32 {
	return FLOOR_HEIGHT + f32(row) * WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT
}

wall_slot_row_at_height :: proc(height: f32) -> int {
	return int(math.floor((height - FLOOR_HEIGHT) / WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT))
}

wall_slot_bounds :: proc(slot: sim.Wall_Slot, footprint: [2]int) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	cells := sim.wall_slot_cells(slot, footprint)
	along_start := f32(cells.minimum.x) / sim.WALL_SLOT_COLUMNS
	along_end := f32(cells.minimum.x + cells.size.x) / sim.WALL_SLOT_COLUMNS
	bottom := wall_slot_row_bottom(cells.minimum.y)
	top := wall_slot_row_bottom(cells.minimum.y + cells.size.y)
	return wall_side_bounds(slot.edge, slot.side, {along_start, along_end}, {bottom, top}, WALL_DECOR_DEPTH)
}

wall_face_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, side: sim.Edge_Side) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return wall_side_bounds(edge, side, {0, 1}, {FLOOR_HEIGHT, WALL_HEIGHT}, 0)
}

wall_side_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, side: sim.Edge_Side, along, height: [2]f32, depth: f32) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	half_thickness: f32 = WALL_THICKNESS / 2
	across_start := half_thickness
	across_end := half_thickness + depth
	if side == .Before do across_start, across_end = -across_end, -across_start
	origin := rl.Vector2{f32(edge.tile.x), f32(edge.tile.y)}
	bottom := height[0]
	top := height[1]
	switch edge.axis {
	case .Horizontal:
		return {min = {origin.x + along[0], bottom, origin.y + across_start}, max = {origin.x + along[1], top, origin.y + across_end}}
	case .Vertical:
		return {min = {origin.x + across_start, bottom, origin.y + along[0]}, max = {origin.x + across_end, top, origin.y + along[1]}}
	}
	unreachable()
}

draw_furnishing :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) {
	draw_shape(furnishing.type, furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing), furnishing_facing(furnishing))
	draw_furnishing_stock(site, furnishing)
	if tile, has_interaction_tile := furnishing.interaction_tile.?; has_interaction_tile {
		draw_tile_outline(tile, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, INTERACTION_MARKER_COLOR)
	}
}

draw_hover_outline :: proc(site: sim.Site, hovered: Maybe(sim.Handle(sim.Furnishing))) {
	handle, is_hovered := hovered.?
	if !is_hovered do return
	furnishing, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, handle)
	if !is_found do return
	rl.DrawBoundingBox(inflate_bounds(furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing), HOVER_OUTLINE_INFLATION), rl.Color(HOVER_OUTLINE_COLOR))
}

furnishing_store :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> Maybe(sim.Item_Store) {
	handle, has_stock := furnishing.stock.?
	if !has_stock do return nil
	return site_store(site, handle)
}

site_store :: proc(site: sim.Site, handle: sim.Handle(sim.Item_Store)) -> sim.Item_Store {
	store, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.stores, handle)
	assert(is_found)
	return store
}

stock_text :: proc(store: sim.Item_Store) -> string {
	reserved := reserved_stock_quantity(store)
	unreserved := sim.store_total_quantity(store) - reserved
	quantity_text := fmt.tprintf("%d", unreserved)
	if reserved > 0 do quantity_text = fmt.tprintf("%s (%d reserved)", quantity_text, reserved)
	if store.role == .Holding do return quantity_text
	return fmt.tprintf("%s/%d", quantity_text, store.capacity)
}

reserved_stock_quantity :: proc(store: sim.Item_Store) -> int {
	total := 0
	for reserved in store.reserved {
		total += reserved
	}
	return total
}

draw_grid_lines :: proc(tile_map: sim.Map) {
	width := f32(tile_map.width)
	height := f32(tile_map.height)
	for column in 0 ..= tile_map.width {
		x := f32(column)
		rl.DrawLine3D({x, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, 0}, {x, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, height}, rl.Color(GRID_LINE_COLOR))
	}
	for row in 0 ..= tile_map.height {
		z := f32(row)
		rl.DrawLine3D({0, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, z}, {width, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, z}, rl.Color(GRID_LINE_COLOR))
	}
}

begin_translucent_pass :: proc() {
	rlgl.DrawRenderBatchActive()
	rlgl.DisableDepthMask()
}

end_translucent_pass :: proc() {
	rlgl.DrawRenderBatchActive()
	rlgl.EnableDepthMask()
}

ghost_tint :: proc(is_valid: bool, alpha: f32) -> ui.Color {
	ghost_color := GHOST_VALID_COLOR if is_valid else GHOST_INVALID_COLOR
	return faded(ghost_color, alpha)
}

faded :: proc(color: ui.Color, alpha: f32) -> ui.Color {
	return ui.Color(rl.Fade(rl.Color(color), alpha))
}

draw_decor_ghost :: proc(site: sim.Site, decor_addition: Maybe(sim.Furnishing_Addition), placement: Maybe(sim.Furnishing_Placement_Result)) {
	addition, is_hovered := decor_addition.?
	if !is_hovered do return
	type := addition.type
	slot := addition.slot
	rotation := addition.rotation
	result, has_result := placement.?
	is_valid := has_result && result == .Valid
	draw_shape(type, slot_bounds(site, type, slot, rotation), slot_facing(slot, rotation), ghost_tint(is_valid, GHOST_FURNISHING_ALPHA))
	if interaction_tile, has_interaction_tile := sim.slot_interaction_tile(site, type, slot, rotation).?; has_interaction_tile {
		is_interaction_tile_valid := sim.check_interaction_tile(site, interaction_tile, rotation) == .Valid
		draw_interaction_tile_ghost(interaction_tile, is_interaction_tile_valid)
	}
}

draw_interaction_tile_ghost :: proc(tile: sim.Tile_Position, is_valid: bool) {
	draw_floor_tile(tile, GHOST_FLOOR_HEIGHT, ghost_tint(is_valid, GHOST_FILL_ALPHA))
	draw_tile_outline(tile, GHOST_FLOOR_HEIGHT, ghost_tint(is_valid, 1))
}

308			draw_floor_tile(tile, FLOOR_HEIGHT, FLOOR_TYPE_COLORS[sim.floor_type_at(tile_map, tile)])

577		top := height[1]

581		case .Vertical:
582			return {min = {origin.x + across_start, bottom, origin.y + along[0]}, max = {origin.x + across_end, top, origin.y + along[1]}}

	return {f32(position.x) / sim.SUBTILES_PER_TILE, FLOOR_HEIGHT, f32(position.y) / sim.SUBTILES_PER_TILE}
}

draw_floor_rectangle :: proc(rectangle: sim.Tile_Rectangle, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	rl.DrawPlane(rectangle_center(rectangle, height), {f32(rectangle.size.x), f32(rectangle.size.y)}, rl.Color(color))
}

draw_floor_tile :: proc(tile: sim.Tile_Position, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	draw_floor_rectangle(sim.single_tile_rectangle(tile), height, color)
}

edge_slab_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, bottom, top: f32) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	half_thickness: f32 = WALL_THICKNESS / 2
	start := rl.Vector3{f32(edge.tile.x), bottom, f32(edge.tile.y)}
	end := start
	switch edge.axis {
	case .Horizontal:
		end.x += 1
	case .Vertical:
		end.z += 1
	}
	return {min = start - {half_thickness, 0, half_thickness}, max = {end.x + half_thickness, top, end.z + half_thickness}}
}

draw_wall :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, inflation: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	draw_box(inflate_bounds(edge_slab_bounds(edge, FLOOR_HEIGHT, WALL_HEIGHT), inflation), color)
}

draw_door_marker :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	draw_box(edge_slab_bounds(edge, FLOOR_HEIGHT, height), color)
}

draw_rectangle_outline :: proc(rectangle: sim.Tile_Rectangle, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	bounds := tile_rectangle_bounds(rectangle, height, height)
	corners := [?]rl.Vector3 {
		{bounds.min.x, height, bounds.min.z},
		{bounds.max.x, height, bounds.min.z},
		{bounds.max.x, height, bounds.max.z},
		{bounds.min.x, height, bounds.max.z},
	}
	for corner, index in corners {
		rl.DrawLine3D(corner, corners[(index + 1) % len(corners)], rl.Color(color))
	}
}

draw_tile_outline :: proc(tile: sim.Tile_Position, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	draw_rectangle_outline(sim.single_tile_rectangle(tile), height, color)
}

light_level :: proc(normal: rl.Vector3) -> f32 {
	return AMBIENT_LIGHT + (1 - AMBIENT_LIGHT) * max(linalg.dot(normal, UNIT_LIGHT_DIRECTION), 0)
}

draw_face :: proc(first, second, third, fourth: rl.Vector3, outward_normal: rl.Vector3, color: ui.Color) {
	shaded_color := rl.ColorBrightness(rl.Color(color), light_level(outward_normal) - 1)
	rl.DrawTriangle3D(first, second, third, shaded_color)
	rl.DrawTriangle3D(first, third, fourth, shaded_color)
}

draw_box :: proc(bounds: rl.BoundingBox, color: ui.Color) {
	low, high := bounds.min, bounds.max
	draw_face({low.x, high.y, low.z}, {low.x, high.y, high.z}, {high.x, high.y, high.z}, {high.x, high.y, low.z}, {0, 1, 0}, color)
	draw_face({high.x, low.y, low.z}, {high.x, high.y, low.z}, {high.x, high.y, high.z}, {high.x, low.y, high.z}, {1, 0, 0}, color)
	draw_face({low.x, low.y, low.z}, {low.x, low.y, high.z}, {low.x, high.y, high.z}, {low.x, high.y, low.z}, {-1, 0, 0}, color)
	draw_face({low.x, low.y, high.z}, {high.x, low.y, high.z}, {high.x, high.y, high.z}, {low.x, high.y, high.z}, {0, 0, 1}, color)
	draw_face({low.x, low.y, low.z}, {low.x, high.y, low.z}, {high.x, high.y, low.z}, {high.x, low.y, low.z}, {0, 0, -1}, color)
}

draw_box_on :: proc(point: rl.Vector3, half_size, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	horizontal_half_size := rl.Vector3{half_size, 0, half_size}
	draw_box({min = point - horizontal_half_size, max = point + horizontal_half_size + {0, height, 0}}, color)
}

draw_site :: proc(site: sim.Site, walls: Wall_View) {
	tile_map := site.tile_map
	for index in 0 ..< len(tile_map.tiles) {
		tile := sim.tile_at_index(tile_map, index)
		draw_floor_tile(tile, FLOOR_HEIGHT, FLOOR_TYPE_COLORS[sim.floor_type_at(tile_map, tile)])
	}
	for slot in site.rooms.slots {
		if !slot.is_occupied do continue
		overlay_color := room_occupancy_overlay_color(slot.value) or_continue
		for tile in slot.value.region {
			draw_floor_tile(tile, ROOM_OCCUPANCY_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, overlay_color)
		}
	}
	draw_walls(walls)
	for slot in site.furnishings.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && is_furnishing_shown(site, walls, slot.value) do draw_furnishing(site, slot.value)
	}
	draw_piles(site)
	for slot in site.rooms.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && sim.is_guest_room(site, slot.value) && sim.is_room_closed(slot.value) do draw_closed_hatch(slot.value)
	}
	draw_grid_lines(tile_map)
	draw_guests(site)
	draw_crew(site)
}

room_occupancy_overlay_color :: proc(room: sim.Room) -> (color: ui.Color, has_overlay: bool) {
	switch _ in room.occupancy {
	case sim.Reserved:
		return faded(RESERVED_ROOM_OVERLAY_COLOR, ROOM_OCCUPANCY_OVERLAY_ALPHA), true
	case sim.Occupied:
		return faded(OCCUPIED_ROOM_OVERLAY_COLOR, ROOM_OCCUPANCY_OVERLAY_ALPHA), true
	}
	return {}, false
}

draw_closed_hatch :: proc(room: sim.Room) {
	for tile in room.region {
		bounds := tile_rectangle_bounds(sim.single_tile_rectangle(tile), FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT)
		rl.DrawLine3D(bounds.min, bounds.max, rl.Color(CLOSED_HATCH_COLOR))
	}
}

room_status_label_tile :: proc(site: sim.Site, room: sim.Room) -> (sim.Tile_Position, bool) {
	first_free_tile: Maybe(sim.Tile_Position)
	for tile in room.region {
		if !is_room_tile_free_for_label(site, room, tile) do continue
		if first_free_tile == nil do first_free_tile = tile
		if is_room_tile_free_for_label(site, room, tile + sim.DIRECTION_OFFSETS[.East]) do return tile, true
	}
	return first_free_tile.?
}

is_room_tile_free_for_label :: proc(site: sim.Site, room: sim.Room, tile: sim.Tile_Position) -> bool {
	if !slice.contains(room.region[:], tile) do return false
	for handle in room.furnishings {
		furnishing, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, handle)
		if is_found && sim.is_tile_in_rectangle(furnishing.tiles, tile) do return false
	}
	return true
}

guest_state_color :: proc(state: sim.Guest_State) -> ui.Color {
	switch _ in state {
	case sim.Walking_To_Desk:
		return WALKING_TO_DESK_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.In_Line:
		return IN_LINE_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Checking_In:
		return CHECKING_IN_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Walking_To_Room:
		return WALKING_TO_ROOM_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Choosing:
		return CHOOSING_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Walking_To_Furnishing:
		return WALKING_TO_FURNISHING_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Using_Furnishing:
		return USING_FURNISHING_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Away:
		return AWAY_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Leaving:
		return LEAVING_GUEST_COLOR
	}
	unreachable()
}

draw_agent_body :: proc(foot: rl.Vector3, color: ui.Color) {
	rl.DrawCapsule(foot + {0, AGENT_RADIUS, 0}, foot + {0, AGENT_HEIGHT - AGENT_RADIUS, 0}, AGENT_RADIUS, AGENT_CAPSULE_SLICES, AGENT_CAPSULE_RINGS, rl.Color(color))
}

on_site_guest_foot :: proc(site: sim.Site, guest: sim.Guest) -> (rl.Vector3, bool) {
	if !sim.is_guest_on_site(guest) do return {}, false
	agent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.agents, sim.guest_agent_handle(guest))
	assert(is_found)
	return subtile_floor_point(agent.position), true
}

crew_foot :: proc(site: sim.Site, crew: sim.Crew) -> rl.Vector3 {
	agent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.agents, crew.agent)
	assert(is_found)
	return subtile_floor_point(agent.position)
}

draw_guests :: proc(site: sim.Site) {
	for slot in site.guests.slots {
		if !slot.is_occupied do continue
		guest := slot.value
		foot := on_site_guest_foot(site, guest) or_continue
		rl.DrawCylinder(foot, GUEST_BASE_RADIUS, GUEST_BASE_RADIUS, AGENT_BASE_HEIGHT, GUEST_BASE_SLICES, rl.Color(arrival_outline_color(guest.arrival_type)))
		draw_agent_body(foot, guest_state_color(guest.state))
	}
}

crew_state_color :: proc(state: sim.Crew_State) -> ui.Color {
	switch _ in state {
	case sim.Idle:
		return IDLE_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Walking_To_Job:
		return WALKING_TO_JOB_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Working:
		return WORKING_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Returning:
		return RETURNING_CREW_COLOR
	}
	unreachable()
}

draw_crew :: proc(site: sim.Site) {
	for slot, index in site.crew.slots {
		if !slot.is_occupied do continue
		foot := crew_foot(site, slot.value)
		draw_box_on(foot, CREW_BASE_HALF_SIZE, AGENT_BASE_HEIGHT, CREW_OUTLINE_COLOR)
		draw_agent_body(foot, crew_state_color(slot.value.state))
		if _, is_carrying := sim.crew_carried_item(site, sim.pool_slot_handle(site.crew, index)); is_carrying do draw_carried_box(foot)
	}
}

draw_carried_box :: proc(foot: rl.Vector3) {
	draw_box_on(foot + {0, AGENT_HEIGHT + CARRIED_BOX_CLEARANCE, 0}, CARRIED_BOX_HALF_SIZE, CARRIED_BOX_HALF_SIZE * 2, CARRIED_BOX_COLOR)
}

job_activity_text :: proc(work: sim.Job_Work) -> (text: string, has_activity: bool) {
	switch value in work {
	case sim.Room_Upkeep:
		return UPKEEP_ACTIVITY_LABELS[value.task], true
	case sim.Haul:
		return HAUL_ACTIVITY_LABELS[haul_stage(value)], true
	}
	return "", false
}

haul_stage :: proc(haul: sim.Haul) -> Haul_Stage {
	return .Drop_Off if haul.is_picked_up else .Pick_Up
}

away_guest_count :: proc(site: sim.Site) -> int {
	count := 0
	for slot in site.guests.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && !sim.is_guest_on_site(slot.value) do count += 1
	}
	return count
}

open_job_count :: proc(site: sim.Site) -> int {
	count := 0
	for slot in site.jobs.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && sim.can_job_take_crew(site, slot.value) do count += 1
	}
	return count
}

guest_activity_text :: proc(site: sim.Site, state: sim.Guest_State) -> (text: string, has_activity: bool) {
	#partial switch value in state {
	case sim.Walking_To_Furnishing:
		furnishing := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, value.furnishing) or_return
		if sim.ACTIVITY_ADVERTISEMENTS[value.activity].is_off_site do return fmt.tprintf("-> %s", OFF_SITE_DESTINATION_LABEL), true
		return fmt.tprintf("-> %s", FURNISHING_LABELS[furnishing.type]), true
	case sim.Using_Furnishing:
		return GUEST_ACTIVITY_LABELS[value.activity], true
	}
	return "", false
}

furnishing_tiles_bounds :: proc(type: sim.Furnishing_Type, tiles: sim.Tile_Rectangle) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return tile_rectangle_bounds(tiles, FLOOR_HEIGHT, shape_height(type))
}

furnishing_bounds :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return placed_furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing.type, furnishing.tiles, furnishing.slot, furnishing.rotation)
}

placed_furnishing_bounds :: proc(
	site: sim.Site,
	type: sim.Furnishing_Type,
	tiles: sim.Tile_Rectangle,
	slot: Maybe(sim.Slot),
	rotation: sim.Rotation,
) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	mounted, has_slot := slot.?
	if !has_slot do return furnishing_tiles_bounds(type, tiles)
	return slot_bounds(site, type, mounted, rotation)
}

furnishing_facing :: proc(furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> sim.Rotation {
	slot, has_slot := furnishing.slot.?
	if !has_slot do return facing_toward_tile(furnishing.tiles, furnishing.interaction_tile)
	return slot_facing(slot, furnishing.rotation)
}

slot_facing :: proc(slot: sim.Slot, rotation: sim.Rotation) -> sim.Rotation {
	wall_slot, is_on_wall := slot.(sim.Wall_Slot)
	if is_on_wall do return wall_slot_facing(wall_slot)
	return rotation
}

slot_bounds :: proc(site: sim.Site, type: sim.Furnishing_Type, slot: sim.Slot, rotation: sim.Rotation) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	footprint := sim.FURNISHING_DEFINITIONS[type].footprint
	switch s in slot {
	case sim.Floor_Slot:
		cells := sim.floor_slot_cells(s, footprint, rotation)
		minimum := cell_floor_point(cells.minimum)
		maximum := cell_floor_point(cells.minimum + cells.size)
		return {min = {minimum.x, FLOOR_HEIGHT, minimum.y}, max = {maximum.x, shape_height(type), maximum.y}}
	case sim.Wall_Slot:
		return wall_slot_bounds(s, footprint)
	case sim.Surface_Slot:
		parent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, s.parent)
		assert(is_found)
		parent_bounds := furnishing_bounds(site, parent)
		center := (parent_bounds.min + parent_bounds.max) / 2
		half_size := cell_floor_point(sim.rotate_size(footprint, rotation)) / 2
		return {
			min = {center.x - half_size.x, parent_bounds.max.y, center.z - half_size.y},
			max = {center.x + half_size.x, parent_bounds.max.y + shape_height(type), center.z + half_size.y},
		}
	}
	unreachable()
}

cell_floor_point :: proc(cell: [2]int) -> rl.Vector2 {
	return {f32(cell.x) / sim.FLOOR_SLOTS_PER_TILE_SIDE, f32(cell.y) / sim.FLOOR_SLOTS_PER_TILE_SIDE}
}

WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT :: (WALL_HEIGHT - FLOOR_HEIGHT) / sim.WALL_SLOT_ROWS

wall_slot_row_bottom :: proc(row: int) -> f32 {
	return FLOOR_HEIGHT + f32(row) * WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT
}

wall_slot_row_at_height :: proc(height: f32) -> int {
	return int(math.floor((height - FLOOR_HEIGHT) / WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT))
}

wall_slot_bounds :: proc(slot: sim.Wall_Slot, footprint: [2]int) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	cells := sim.wall_slot_cells(slot, footprint)
	along_start := f32(cells.minimum.x) / sim.WALL_SLOT_COLUMNS
	along_end := f32(cells.minimum.x + cells.size.x) / sim.WALL_SLOT_COLUMNS
	bottom := wall_slot_row_bottom(cells.minimum.y)
	top := wall_slot_row_bottom(cells.minimum.y + cells.size.y)
	return wall_side_bounds(slot.edge, slot.side, {along_start, along_end}, {bottom, top}, WALL_DECOR_DEPTH)
}

wall_face_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, side: sim.Edge_Side) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return wall_side_bounds(edge, side, {0, 1}, {FLOOR_HEIGHT, WALL_HEIGHT}, 0)
}

wall_side_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, side: sim.Edge_Side, along, height: [2]f32, depth: f32) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	half_thickness: f32 = WALL_THICKNESS / 2
	across_start := half_thickness
	across_end := half_thickness + depth
	if side == .Before do across_start, across_end = -across_end, -across_start
	origin := rl.Vector2{f32(edge.tile.x), f32(edge.tile.y)}
	bottom := height[0]
	top := height[1]
	switch edge.axis {
	case .Horizontal:
		return {min = {origin.x + along[0], bottom, origin.y + across_start}, max = {origin.x + along[1], top, origin.y + across_end}}
	case .Vertical:
		return {min = {origin.x + across_start, bottom, origin.y + along[0]}, max = {origin.x + across_end, top, origin.y + along[1]}}
	}
	unreachable()
}

draw_furnishing :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) {
	draw_shape(furnishing.type, furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing), furnishing_facing(furnishing))
	draw_furnishing_stock(site, furnishing)
	if tile, has_interaction_tile := furnishing.interaction_tile.?; has_interaction_tile {
		draw_tile_outline(tile, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, INTERACTION_MARKER_COLOR)
	}
}

draw_hover_outline :: proc(site: sim.Site, hovered: Maybe(sim.Handle(sim.Furnishing))) {
	handle, is_hovered := hovered.?
	if !is_hovered do return
	furnishing, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, handle)
	if !is_found do return
	rl.DrawBoundingBox(inflate_bounds(furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing), HOVER_OUTLINE_INFLATION), rl.Color(HOVER_OUTLINE_COLOR))
}

furnishing_store :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> Maybe(sim.Item_Store) {
	handle, has_stock := furnishing.stock.?
	if !has_stock do return nil
	return site_store(site, handle)
}

site_store :: proc(site: sim.Site, handle: sim.Handle(sim.Item_Store)) -> sim.Item_Store {
	store, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.stores, handle)
	assert(is_found)
	return store
}

stock_text :: proc(store: sim.Item_Store) -> string {
	reserved := reserved_stock_quantity(store)
	unreserved := sim.store_total_quantity(store) - reserved
	quantity_text := fmt.tprintf("%d", unreserved)
	if reserved > 0 do quantity_text = fmt.tprintf("%s (%d reserved)", quantity_text, reserved)
	if store.role == .Holding do return quantity_text
	return fmt.tprintf("%s/%d", quantity_text, store.capacity)
}

reserved_stock_quantity :: proc(store: sim.Item_Store) -> int {
	total := 0
	for reserved in store.reserved {
		total += reserved
	}
	return total
}

draw_grid_lines :: proc(tile_map: sim.Map) {
	width := f32(tile_map.width)
	height := f32(tile_map.height)
	for column in 0 ..= tile_map.width {
		x := f32(column)
		rl.DrawLine3D({x, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, 0}, {x, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, height}, rl.Color(GRID_LINE_COLOR))
	}
	for row in 0 ..= tile_map.height {
		z := f32(row)
		rl.DrawLine3D({0, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, z}, {width, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, z}, rl.Color(GRID_LINE_COLOR))
	}
}

begin_translucent_pass :: proc() {
	rlgl.DrawRenderBatchActive()
	rlgl.DisableDepthMask()
}

end_translucent_pass :: proc() {
	rlgl.DrawRenderBatchActive()
	rlgl.EnableDepthMask()
}

ghost_tint :: proc(is_valid: bool, alpha: f32) -> ui.Color {
	ghost_color := GHOST_VALID_COLOR if is_valid else GHOST_INVALID_COLOR
	return faded(ghost_color, alpha)
}

faded :: proc(color: ui.Color, alpha: f32) -> ui.Color {
	return ui.Color(rl.Fade(rl.Color(color), alpha))
}

draw_decor_ghost :: proc(site: sim.Site, decor_addition: Maybe(sim.Furnishing_Addition), placement: Maybe(sim.Furnishing_Placement_Result)) {
	addition, is_hovered := decor_addition.?
	if !is_hovered do return
	type := addition.type
	slot := addition.slot
	rotation := addition.rotation
	result, has_result := placement.?
	is_valid := has_result && result == .Valid
	draw_shape(type, slot_bounds(site, type, slot, rotation), slot_facing(slot, rotation), ghost_tint(is_valid, GHOST_FURNISHING_ALPHA))
	if interaction_tile, has_interaction_tile := sim.slot_interaction_tile(site, type, slot, rotation).?; has_interaction_tile {
		is_interaction_tile_valid := sim.check_interaction_tile(site, interaction_tile, rotation) == .Valid
		draw_interaction_tile_ghost(interaction_tile, is_interaction_tile_valid)
	}
}

draw_interaction_tile_ghost :: proc(tile: sim.Tile_Position, is_valid: bool) {
	draw_floor_tile(tile, GHOST_FLOOR_HEIGHT, ghost_tint(is_valid, GHOST_FILL_ALPHA))
	draw_tile_outline(tile, GHOST_FLOOR_HEIGHT, ghost_tint(is_valid, 1))
}

521		switch s in slot {
522		case sim.Floor_Slot:
523			cells := sim.floor_slot_cells(s, footprint, rotation)
524			minimum := cell_floor_point(cells.minimum)
525			maximum := cell_floor_point(cells.minimum + cells.size)
526			return {min = {minimum.x, FLOOR_HEIGHT, minimum.y}, max = {maximum.x, shape_height(type), maximum.y}}
527		case sim.Wall_Slot:

529		case sim.Surface_Slot:
530			parent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, s.parent)
531			assert(is_found)
532			parent_bounds := furnishing_bounds(site, parent)
533			center := (parent_bounds.min + parent_bounds.max) / 2
534			half_size := cell_floor_point(sim.rotate_size(footprint, rotation)) / 2
535			return {

537				max = {center.x + half_size.x, parent_bounds.max.y + shape_height(type), center.z + half_size.y},

570	wall_side_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, side: sim.Edge_Side, along, height: [2]f32, depth: f32) -> rl.BoundingBox {
571		half_thickness: f32 = WALL_THICKNESS / 2
572		across_start := half_thickness
573		across_end := half_thickness + depth
574		if side == .Before do across_start, across_end = -across_end, -across_start
575		origin := rl.Vector2{f32(edge.tile.x), f32(edge.tile.y)}
576		bottom := height[0]
577		top := height[1]
578		switch edge.axis {
579		case .Horizontal:
580			return {min = {origin.x + along[0], bottom, origin.y + across_start}, max = {origin.x + along[1], top, origin.y + across_end}}
581		case .Vertical:
582			return {min = {origin.x + across_start, bottom, origin.y + along[0]}, max = {origin.x + across_end, top, origin.y + along[1]}}
583		}
584		unreachable()

rectangle_center :: proc(rectangle: sim.Tile_Rectangle, height: f32) -> rl.Vector3 {
	return {f32(rectangle.minimum.x) + f32(rectangle.size.x) / 2, height, f32(rectangle.minimum.y) + f32(rectangle.size.y) / 2}
}

tile_center :: proc(tile: sim.Tile_Position, height: f32) -> rl.Vector3 {
	return rectangle_center(sim.single_tile_rectangle(tile), height)
}

tile_rectangle_bounds :: proc(rectangle: sim.Tile_Rectangle, bottom, top: f32) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	maximum := rectangle.minimum.xy + rectangle.size
	return {
		min = {f32(rectangle.minimum.x), bottom, f32(rectangle.minimum.y)},
		max = {f32(maximum.x), top, f32(maximum.y)},
	}
}

inflate_bounds :: proc(bounds: rl.BoundingBox, amount: f32) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return {min = bounds.min - amount, max = bounds.max + amount}
}

subtile_floor_point :: proc(position: sim.Subtile_Position) -> rl.Vector3 {
	return {f32(position.x) / sim.SUBTILES_PER_TILE, FLOOR_HEIGHT, f32(position.y) / sim.SUBTILES_PER_TILE}
}

draw_floor_rectangle :: proc(rectangle: sim.Tile_Rectangle, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	rl.DrawPlane(rectangle_center(rectangle, height), {f32(rectangle.size.x), f32(rectangle.size.y)}, rl.Color(color))
}

draw_floor_tile :: proc(tile: sim.Tile_Position, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	draw_floor_rectangle(sim.single_tile_rectangle(tile), height, color)
}

edge_slab_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, bottom, top: f32) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	half_thickness: f32 = WALL_THICKNESS / 2
	start := rl.Vector3{f32(edge.tile.x), bottom, f32(edge.tile.y)}
	end := start
	switch edge.axis {
	case .Horizontal:
		end.x += 1
	case .Vertical:
		end.z += 1
	}
	return {min = start - {half_thickness, 0, half_thickness}, max = {end.x + half_thickness, top, end.z + half_thickness}}
}

draw_wall :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, inflation: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	draw_box(inflate_bounds(edge_slab_bounds(edge, FLOOR_HEIGHT, WALL_HEIGHT), inflation), color)
}

draw_door_marker :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	draw_box(edge_slab_bounds(edge, FLOOR_HEIGHT, height), color)
}

draw_rectangle_outline :: proc(rectangle: sim.Tile_Rectangle, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	bounds := tile_rectangle_bounds(rectangle, height, height)
	corners := [?]rl.Vector3 {
		{bounds.min.x, height, bounds.min.z},
		{bounds.max.x, height, bounds.min.z},
		{bounds.max.x, height, bounds.max.z},
		{bounds.min.x, height, bounds.max.z},
	}
	for corner, index in corners {
		rl.DrawLine3D(corner, corners[(index + 1) % len(corners)], rl.Color(color))
	}
}

draw_tile_outline :: proc(tile: sim.Tile_Position, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	draw_rectangle_outline(sim.single_tile_rectangle(tile), height, color)
}

light_level :: proc(normal: rl.Vector3) -> f32 {
	return AMBIENT_LIGHT + (1 - AMBIENT_LIGHT) * max(linalg.dot(normal, UNIT_LIGHT_DIRECTION), 0)
}

draw_face :: proc(first, second, third, fourth: rl.Vector3, outward_normal: rl.Vector3, color: ui.Color) {
	shaded_color := rl.ColorBrightness(rl.Color(color), light_level(outward_normal) - 1)
	rl.DrawTriangle3D(first, second, third, shaded_color)
	rl.DrawTriangle3D(first, third, fourth, shaded_color)
}

draw_box :: proc(bounds: rl.BoundingBox, color: ui.Color) {
	low, high := bounds.min, bounds.max
	draw_face({low.x, high.y, low.z}, {low.x, high.y, high.z}, {high.x, high.y, high.z}, {high.x, high.y, low.z}, {0, 1, 0}, color)
	draw_face({high.x, low.y, low.z}, {high.x, high.y, low.z}, {high.x, high.y, high.z}, {high.x, low.y, high.z}, {1, 0, 0}, color)
	draw_face({low.x, low.y, low.z}, {low.x, low.y, high.z}, {low.x, high.y, high.z}, {low.x, high.y, low.z}, {-1, 0, 0}, color)
	draw_face({low.x, low.y, high.z}, {high.x, low.y, high.z}, {high.x, high.y, high.z}, {low.x, high.y, high.z}, {0, 0, 1}, color)
	draw_face({low.x, low.y, low.z}, {low.x, high.y, low.z}, {high.x, high.y, low.z}, {high.x, low.y, low.z}, {0, 0, -1}, color)
}

draw_box_on :: proc(point: rl.Vector3, half_size, height: f32, color: ui.Color) {
	horizontal_half_size := rl.Vector3{half_size, 0, half_size}
	draw_box({min = point - horizontal_half_size, max = point + horizontal_half_size + {0, height, 0}}, color)
}

draw_site :: proc(site: sim.Site, walls: Wall_View) {
	tile_map := site.tile_map
	for index in 0 ..< len(tile_map.tiles) {
		tile := sim.tile_at_index(tile_map, index)
		draw_floor_tile(tile, FLOOR_HEIGHT, FLOOR_TYPE_COLORS[sim.floor_type_at(tile_map, tile)])
	}
	for slot in site.rooms.slots {
		if !slot.is_occupied do continue
		overlay_color := room_occupancy_overlay_color(slot.value) or_continue
		for tile in slot.value.region {
			draw_floor_tile(tile, ROOM_OCCUPANCY_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, overlay_color)
		}
	}
	draw_walls(walls)
	for slot in site.furnishings.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && is_furnishing_shown(site, walls, slot.value) do draw_furnishing(site, slot.value)
	}
	draw_piles(site)
	for slot in site.rooms.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && sim.is_guest_room(site, slot.value) && sim.is_room_closed(slot.value) do draw_closed_hatch(slot.value)
	}
	draw_grid_lines(tile_map)
	draw_guests(site)
	draw_crew(site)
}

room_occupancy_overlay_color :: proc(room: sim.Room) -> (color: ui.Color, has_overlay: bool) {
	switch _ in room.occupancy {
	case sim.Reserved:
		return faded(RESERVED_ROOM_OVERLAY_COLOR, ROOM_OCCUPANCY_OVERLAY_ALPHA), true
	case sim.Occupied:
		return faded(OCCUPIED_ROOM_OVERLAY_COLOR, ROOM_OCCUPANCY_OVERLAY_ALPHA), true
	}
	return {}, false
}

draw_closed_hatch :: proc(room: sim.Room) {
	for tile in room.region {
		bounds := tile_rectangle_bounds(sim.single_tile_rectangle(tile), FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT)
		rl.DrawLine3D(bounds.min, bounds.max, rl.Color(CLOSED_HATCH_COLOR))
	}
}

room_status_label_tile :: proc(site: sim.Site, room: sim.Room) -> (sim.Tile_Position, bool) {
	first_free_tile: Maybe(sim.Tile_Position)
	for tile in room.region {
		if !is_room_tile_free_for_label(site, room, tile) do continue
		if first_free_tile == nil do first_free_tile = tile
		if is_room_tile_free_for_label(site, room, tile + sim.DIRECTION_OFFSETS[.East]) do return tile, true
	}
	return first_free_tile.?
}

is_room_tile_free_for_label :: proc(site: sim.Site, room: sim.Room, tile: sim.Tile_Position) -> bool {
	if !slice.contains(room.region[:], tile) do return false
	for handle in room.furnishings {
		furnishing, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, handle)
		if is_found && sim.is_tile_in_rectangle(furnishing.tiles, tile) do return false
	}
	return true
}

	switch _ in state {
	case sim.Walking_To_Desk:
		return WALKING_TO_DESK_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.In_Line:
		return IN_LINE_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Checking_In:
		return CHECKING_IN_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Walking_To_Room:
		return WALKING_TO_ROOM_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Choosing:
		return CHOOSING_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Walking_To_Furnishing:
		return WALKING_TO_FURNISHING_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Using_Furnishing:
		return USING_FURNISHING_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Away:
		return AWAY_GUEST_COLOR
	case sim.Leaving:
		return LEAVING_GUEST_COLOR
	}
	unreachable()
}

draw_agent_body :: proc(foot: rl.Vector3, color: ui.Color) {
	rl.DrawCapsule(foot + {0, AGENT_RADIUS, 0}, foot + {0, AGENT_HEIGHT - AGENT_RADIUS, 0}, AGENT_RADIUS, AGENT_CAPSULE_SLICES, AGENT_CAPSULE_RINGS, rl.Color(color))
}

on_site_guest_foot :: proc(site: sim.Site, guest: sim.Guest) -> (rl.Vector3, bool) {
	if !sim.is_guest_on_site(guest) do return {}, false
	agent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.agents, sim.guest_agent_handle(guest))
	assert(is_found)
	return subtile_floor_point(agent.position), true
}

crew_foot :: proc(site: sim.Site, crew: sim.Crew) -> rl.Vector3 {
	agent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.agents, crew.agent)
	assert(is_found)
	return subtile_floor_point(agent.position)
}

draw_guests :: proc(site: sim.Site) {
	for slot in site.guests.slots {
		if !slot.is_occupied do continue
		guest := slot.value
		foot := on_site_guest_foot(site, guest) or_continue
		rl.DrawCylinder(foot, GUEST_BASE_RADIUS, GUEST_BASE_RADIUS, AGENT_BASE_HEIGHT, GUEST_BASE_SLICES, rl.Color(arrival_outline_color(guest.arrival_type)))
		draw_agent_body(foot, guest_state_color(guest.state))
	}
}

crew_state_color :: proc(state: sim.Crew_State) -> ui.Color {
	switch _ in state {
	case sim.Idle:
		return IDLE_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Walking_To_Job:
		return WALKING_TO_JOB_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Working:
		return WORKING_CREW_COLOR
	case sim.Returning:
		return RETURNING_CREW_COLOR
	}
	unreachable()
}

draw_crew :: proc(site: sim.Site) {
	for slot, index in site.crew.slots {
		if !slot.is_occupied do continue
		foot := crew_foot(site, slot.value)
		draw_box_on(foot, CREW_BASE_HALF_SIZE, AGENT_BASE_HEIGHT, CREW_OUTLINE_COLOR)
		draw_agent_body(foot, crew_state_color(slot.value.state))
		if _, is_carrying := sim.crew_carried_item(site, sim.pool_slot_handle(site.crew, index)); is_carrying do draw_carried_box(foot)
	}
}

draw_carried_box :: proc(foot: rl.Vector3) {
	draw_box_on(foot + {0, AGENT_HEIGHT + CARRIED_BOX_CLEARANCE, 0}, CARRIED_BOX_HALF_SIZE, CARRIED_BOX_HALF_SIZE * 2, CARRIED_BOX_COLOR)
}

	switch value in work {
	case sim.Room_Upkeep:
		return UPKEEP_ACTIVITY_LABELS[value.task], true
	case sim.Haul:
		return HAUL_ACTIVITY_LABELS[haul_stage(value)], true
	}
	return "", false
}

haul_stage :: proc(haul: sim.Haul) -> Haul_Stage {
	return .Drop_Off if haul.is_picked_up else .Pick_Up
}

away_guest_count :: proc(site: sim.Site) -> int {
	count := 0
	for slot in site.guests.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && !sim.is_guest_on_site(slot.value) do count += 1
	}
	return count
}

open_job_count :: proc(site: sim.Site) -> int {
	count := 0
	for slot in site.jobs.slots {
		if slot.is_occupied && sim.can_job_take_crew(site, slot.value) do count += 1
	}
	return count
}

guest_activity_text :: proc(site: sim.Site, state: sim.Guest_State) -> (text: string, has_activity: bool) {
	#partial switch value in state {
	case sim.Walking_To_Furnishing:
		furnishing := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, value.furnishing) or_return
		if sim.ACTIVITY_ADVERTISEMENTS[value.activity].is_off_site do return fmt.tprintf("-> %s", OFF_SITE_DESTINATION_LABEL), true
		return fmt.tprintf("-> %s", FURNISHING_LABELS[furnishing.type]), true

furnishing_tiles_bounds :: proc(type: sim.Furnishing_Type, tiles: sim.Tile_Rectangle) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return tile_rectangle_bounds(tiles, FLOOR_HEIGHT, shape_height(type))
}

furnishing_bounds :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return placed_furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing.type, furnishing.tiles, furnishing.slot, furnishing.rotation)
}

placed_furnishing_bounds :: proc(
	site: sim.Site,
	type: sim.Furnishing_Type,
	tiles: sim.Tile_Rectangle,
	slot: Maybe(sim.Slot),
	rotation: sim.Rotation,
) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	mounted, has_slot := slot.?
	if !has_slot do return furnishing_tiles_bounds(type, tiles)
	return slot_bounds(site, type, mounted, rotation)
}

furnishing_facing :: proc(furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> sim.Rotation {
	slot, has_slot := furnishing.slot.?
	if !has_slot do return facing_toward_tile(furnishing.tiles, furnishing.interaction_tile)
	return slot_facing(slot, furnishing.rotation)
}

slot_facing :: proc(slot: sim.Slot, rotation: sim.Rotation) -> sim.Rotation {
	wall_slot, is_on_wall := slot.(sim.Wall_Slot)
	if is_on_wall do return wall_slot_facing(wall_slot)
	return rotation
}

slot_bounds :: proc(site: sim.Site, type: sim.Furnishing_Type, slot: sim.Slot, rotation: sim.Rotation) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	footprint := sim.FURNISHING_DEFINITIONS[type].footprint
	switch s in slot {
	case sim.Floor_Slot:
		cells := sim.floor_slot_cells(s, footprint, rotation)
		minimum := cell_floor_point(cells.minimum)
		maximum := cell_floor_point(cells.minimum + cells.size)
		return {min = {minimum.x, FLOOR_HEIGHT, minimum.y}, max = {maximum.x, shape_height(type), maximum.y}}
	case sim.Wall_Slot:
		return wall_slot_bounds(s, footprint)
	case sim.Surface_Slot:
		parent, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, s.parent)
		assert(is_found)
		parent_bounds := furnishing_bounds(site, parent)
		center := (parent_bounds.min + parent_bounds.max) / 2
		half_size := cell_floor_point(sim.rotate_size(footprint, rotation)) / 2
		return {
			min = {center.x - half_size.x, parent_bounds.max.y, center.z - half_size.y},
			max = {center.x + half_size.x, parent_bounds.max.y + shape_height(type), center.z + half_size.y},
		}
	}
	unreachable()
}

cell_floor_point :: proc(cell: [2]int) -> rl.Vector2 {
	return {f32(cell.x) / sim.FLOOR_SLOTS_PER_TILE_SIDE, f32(cell.y) / sim.FLOOR_SLOTS_PER_TILE_SIDE}
}

WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT :: (WALL_HEIGHT - FLOOR_HEIGHT) / sim.WALL_SLOT_ROWS

wall_slot_row_bottom :: proc(row: int) -> f32 {
	return FLOOR_HEIGHT + f32(row) * WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT
}

wall_slot_row_at_height :: proc(height: f32) -> int {
	return int(math.floor((height - FLOOR_HEIGHT) / WALL_SLOT_ROW_HEIGHT))
}

wall_slot_bounds :: proc(slot: sim.Wall_Slot, footprint: [2]int) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	cells := sim.wall_slot_cells(slot, footprint)
	along_start := f32(cells.minimum.x) / sim.WALL_SLOT_COLUMNS
	along_end := f32(cells.minimum.x + cells.size.x) / sim.WALL_SLOT_COLUMNS
	bottom := wall_slot_row_bottom(cells.minimum.y)
	top := wall_slot_row_bottom(cells.minimum.y + cells.size.y)
	return wall_side_bounds(slot.edge, slot.side, {along_start, along_end}, {bottom, top}, WALL_DECOR_DEPTH)
}

wall_face_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, side: sim.Edge_Side) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	return wall_side_bounds(edge, side, {0, 1}, {FLOOR_HEIGHT, WALL_HEIGHT}, 0)
}

wall_side_bounds :: proc(edge: sim.Edge_Position, side: sim.Edge_Side, along, height: [2]f32, depth: f32) -> rl.BoundingBox {
	half_thickness: f32 = WALL_THICKNESS / 2
	across_start := half_thickness
	across_end := half_thickness + depth
	if side == .Before do across_start, across_end = -across_end, -across_start
	origin := rl.Vector2{f32(edge.tile.x), f32(edge.tile.y)}
	bottom := height[0]
	top := height[1]
	switch edge.axis {
	case .Horizontal:
		return {min = {origin.x + along[0], bottom, origin.y + across_start}, max = {origin.x + along[1], top, origin.y + across_end}}
	case .Vertical:
		return {min = {origin.x + across_start, bottom, origin.y + along[0]}, max = {origin.x + across_end, top, origin.y + along[1]}}
	}
	unreachable()
}

draw_furnishing :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) {
	draw_shape(furnishing.type, furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing), furnishing_facing(furnishing))
	draw_furnishing_stock(site, furnishing)
	if tile, has_interaction_tile := furnishing.interaction_tile.?; has_interaction_tile {
		draw_tile_outline(tile, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, INTERACTION_MARKER_COLOR)
	}
}

draw_hover_outline :: proc(site: sim.Site, hovered: Maybe(sim.Handle(sim.Furnishing))) {
	handle, is_hovered := hovered.?
	if !is_hovered do return
	furnishing, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.furnishings, handle)
	if !is_found do return
	rl.DrawBoundingBox(inflate_bounds(furnishing_bounds(site, furnishing), HOVER_OUTLINE_INFLATION), rl.Color(HOVER_OUTLINE_COLOR))
}

furnishing_store :: proc(site: sim.Site, furnishing: sim.Furnishing) -> Maybe(sim.Item_Store) {
	handle, has_stock := furnishing.stock.?
	if !has_stock do return nil
	return site_store(site, handle)
}

site_store :: proc(site: sim.Site, handle: sim.Handle(sim.Item_Store)) -> sim.Item_Store {
	store, is_found := sim.pool_get_value(site.stores, handle)
	assert(is_found)
	return store
}

stock_text :: proc(store: sim.Item_Store) -> string {
	reserved := reserved_stock_quantity(store)
	unreserved := sim.store_total_quantity(store) - reserved
	quantity_text := fmt.tprintf("%d", unreserved)
	if reserved > 0 do quantity_text = fmt.tprintf("%s (%d reserved)", quantity_text, reserved)
	if store.role == .Holding do return quantity_text
	return fmt.tprintf("%s/%d", quantity_text, store.capacity)
}

reserved_stock_quantity :: proc(store: sim.Item_Store) -> int {
	total := 0
	for reserved in store.reserved {
		total += reserved
	}
	return total
}

draw_grid_lines :: proc(tile_map: sim.Map) {
	width := f32(tile_map.width)
	height := f32(tile_map.height)
	for column in 0 ..= tile_map.width {
		x := f32(column)
		rl.DrawLine3D({x, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, 0}, {x, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, height}, rl.Color(GRID_LINE_COLOR))
	}
	for row in 0 ..= tile_map.height {
		z := f32(row)
		rl.DrawLine3D({0, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, z}, {width, FLOOR_OVERLAY_HEIGHT, z}, rl.Color(GRID_LINE_COLOR))
	}
}

begin_translucent_pass :: proc() {
	rlgl.DrawRenderBatchActive()
	rlgl.DisableDepthMask()
}

end_translucent_pass :: proc() {
	rlgl.DrawRenderBatchActive()
	rlgl.EnableDepthMask()
}

ghost_tint :: proc(is_valid: bool, alpha: f32) -> ui.Color {
	ghost_color := GHOST_VALID_COLOR if is_valid else GHOST_INVALID_COLOR
	return faded(ghost_color, alpha)
}

faded :: proc(color: ui.Color, alpha: f32) -> ui.Color {
	return ui.Color(rl.Fade(rl.Color(color), alpha))
}

draw_decor_ghost :: proc(site: sim.Site, decor_addition: Maybe(sim.Furnishing_Addition), placement: Maybe(sim.Furnishing_Placement_Result)) {
	addition, is_hovered := decor_addition.?
	if !is_hovered do return
	type := addition.type
	slot := addition.slot
	rotation := addition.rotation
	result, has_result := placement.?
	is_valid := has_result && result == .Valid
	draw_shape(type, slot_bounds(site, type, slot, rotation), slot_facing(slot, rotation), ghost_tint(is_valid, GHOST_FURNISHING_ALPHA))
	if interaction_tile, has_interaction_tile := sim.slot_interaction_tile(site, type, slot, rotation).?; has_interaction_tile {
		is_interaction_tile_valid := sim.check_interaction_tile(site, interaction_tile, rotation) == .Valid
		draw_interaction_tile_ghost(interaction_tile, is_interaction_tile_valid)
	}
}

draw_interaction_tile_ghost :: proc(tile: sim.Tile_Position, is_valid: bool) {
	draw_floor_tile(tile, GHOST_FLOOR_HEIGHT, ghost_tint(is_valid, GHOST_FILL_ALPHA))
	draw_tile_outline(tile, GHOST_FLOOR_HEIGHT, ghost_tint(is_valid, 1))
}
